name: io.github.4lador/leantime-mcp
title: Leantime MCP (Unofficial)
description: Unofficial MCP server for Leantime: 42 agent-first tools, backup/restore, dry-run validation

environment_variables.name: LEANTIME_URL
environment_variables.description: Instance URL (per-run override — normally stored in the keyring via 'leantmcp url set')

environment_variables.name: LEANTIME_API_KEY
environment_variables.description: API key (per-run override — normally stored in the keyring via 'leantmcp key set')

environment_variables.name: LEANTIME_INSTANCE
environment_variables.description: Keyring profile to use (for multiple Leantime instances)
